scope: Every player on the 2003-07-01 published free agent list, plus one found by contract history, for all 29 clubs. Facts and rule arithmetic only: no qualifying offer decisions, renouncements or signings are recorded.

rules_applied.bird_class: Seasons without being waived or changing teams as a free agent: three or more is bird, two is early_bird, one is non_bird. A trade keeps the count.
rules_applied.qualifying_offer: Fourth-year rookie scale player: 2002-03 salary plus the scale percentage for his draft pick. Other restricted players: the greater of 125% of 2002-03 salary and the 2003-04 minimum for his years of service plus $150,000.
rules_applied.cap_hold: Bird 150% (prior salary at least the average) or 200% (below); Bird off a rookie scale contract 250% or 300%; Early Bird 130%; Non-Bird 120%; not above the player's maximum salary; two-year average used when the last-year raise exceeded $4 million.

assumptions: Average salary threshold set at $4,917,000, the 2003-04 mid-level exception, which the FAQ says equals the average salary. The FAQ does not print the average itself; players whose salary falls between $4,546,000 and $4,917,000 are flagged.
Maximum salary taken as the greater of the 2003-04 maximum for the player's years of service ($10,960,000, $13,152,000 or $15,344,000) and 105% of his 2002-03 salary.
Years of service counted as seasons with at least one NBA game before 2003-04. A season spent under contract without playing is not counted and could add one.
A season counts toward the Bird clock from the season in which the player signed.
unverified: The cap hold rule for players coming off minimum-salary contracts. The FAQ has no separate rule and the agreement text could not be read; standard percentages are used and each affected player is flagged.

Transaction facts were read from Basketball-Reference season transaction pages by an automated reader, in batches. Dates and types were used; trade directions were not. 117 of 131 listed signings match a club the player then played for, and the other 14 look like training-camp signings.
Re-signings with the same club are not listed on those pages and do not reset the count, so none are recorded.
